protocol: Time-based split: the final 8 weeks of the 2011-2012 hourly series are the test window; the 8 weeks before it are validation (model selection, LightGBM HPO, MLP early stopping and shipped ablation configuration); everything earlier is training. Each candidate receives one test score. Ablation variants are also test-scored only after freezing and are labeled post-freeze diagnostics. The champion-vs-floor MAE gap uses paired hourly bootstrap resampling, with paired non-overlapping 24-hour and 168-hour block bootstraps as serial-dependence sensitivity analyses.
limits: Model selection, early stopping and the shipped ablation configuration used validation only. Test scores for all ablation variants are post-freeze diagnostics, not selection evidence.
Hourly errors are serially dependent. Day/week block bootstraps are sensitivity analyses on the same test window, not independent confirmations.
MAPE denominators are floored at 1 rental; near-zero hours inflate MAPE even when the absolute error is small — read MAE first.
Two years and four seasons, one city, one system: transfer to other fleets or regimes is plausible, not measured.
